tips.text: Buy extra relics for Helios Prime Cerebrum; it is the Rare part in every one of them.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Refine the Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and run radshare; leave Common relics Intact.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen so they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
